data.name: Ajin
data.gender_notes: Ajin is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘aj’ meaning ‘not’ and ‘jin’ meaning ‘conqueror’, Ajin is a name that signifies the one who is invincible and immune to death. The name Ajin carries the meaning “Immortal, Invincible” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ajin usually hope their child will grow to embody immortal, invincible and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embodying the qualities of immortality and strength, Ajin is a name that inspires courage and determination in its bearer.
data.etymology: Ajin belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Immortal, Invincible.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ajin total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
